<style id="seo-css">
/* ===========================================================================
   MYSense — SEO landing page (seo.mysense.com.my)
   Third sibling of the DM and IM landing pages. Same type system, same
   component grammar, same motion engine. Different lead colour so the three
   pages read as one family without looking like the same page twice:

     DM landing  -> purple lead
     IM landing  -> pink lead
     SEO landing -> BLUE / NAVY -> CYAN lead, pink as accent, yellow as action

   Type: Montserrat (display) + Manrope (body/UI) only.

   ACTION-COLOUR RULE (measured on the DM build, still governs here):
     yellow #FFCC00 contrast — on navy 9.79, blue 6.78, purple 5.30, ink 11.91
                             — on page bg 1.36, on white 1.51  <- invisible
     => yellow CTAs only ever sit on a dark ground, always with an ink label.
        On white / page-bg the primary becomes a solid BLUE pill, white label
        (#0030B0 on white = 8.59:1).
=========================================================================== */

:root{
  /* -- brand ------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --navy:#001B76;
  --blue:#0030B0;
  --pink:#F24277;
  --purple:#6C00D7;
  --yellow:#FFCC00;
  --cyan:#41CEE2;
  --page:#F1F3FA;
  --ink:#0B1339;
  --white:#fff;

  /* -- derived surfaces (tints and shades of the above, no new hues) ------ */
  --blue-lite:#2E5BE0;        /* gradient light end of --blue */
  --blue-deep:#001F82;
  --navy-deep:#00114D;
  --cyan-deep:#1FA8BC;
  --cyan-soft:#D8F4F8;
  --ink-2:#1B2450;
  --line:rgba(11,19,57,.10);
  --line-on-dark:rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  --muted:#454D68;            /* body on light: 8.35:1 */
  --muted-2:#818AA7;          /* de-emphasised UI text */
  --muted-on-dark:rgba(255,255,255,.78);

  /* the page's one signature gradient: navy -> blue -> cyan, the "climb" */
  --grad-climb:linear-gradient(118deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--blue) 46%,var(--cyan-deep) 100%);
  --grad-climb-soft:linear-gradient(118deg,#001B76 0%,#0030B0 55%,#2C97AB 120%);
  --grad-line:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--blue),var(--pink));

  /* -- type -------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --display:Montserrat,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --body:Manrope,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --mono:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,"SF Mono",Menlo,monospace;

  /* -- shape ------------------------------------------------------------- */
  --r-pill:999px;
  --r-card:24px;
  --r-panel:32px;
  --r-input:14px;
  --r-chip:18px;

  /* -- elevation --------------------------------------------------------- */
  --sh-chip:24px 24px 40px rgba(0,27,118,.26);
  --sh-card:0 10px 34px rgba(11,19,57,.08);
  --sh-lift:0 26px 56px rgba(0,27,118,.16);
  --sh-deck:0 30px 70px rgba(11,19,57,.28);

  /* -- layout ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  --container:1308px;
  --gutter:clamp(20px,5vw,66px);
  --sec-y:clamp(72px,9vw,132px);

  /* -- motion ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  --ease:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
  --ease-hover:cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.56,1);
  --dur-reveal:1050ms;
  --dur-hover:400ms;
}

:where(.seo),:where(.seo) *,:where(.seo) *::before,:where(.seo) *::after{box-sizing:border-box}

.seo{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}

.seo{margin:0;background:var(--page);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}

:where(.seo) img,:where(.seo) svg,:where(.seo) video{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
:where(.seo) button{font:inherit;color:inherit}
:where(.seo) a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

:where(.seo) h1,:where(.seo) h2,:where(.seo) h3,:where(.seo) h4,:where(.seo) h5{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:800;
  margin:0;
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
  line-height:1;
}

:where(.seo) p{margin:0}

.wrap{
  width:100%;
  max-width:var(--container);
  margin-inline:auto;
  padding-inline:var(--gutter);
}
.wrap--narrow{max-width:1020px}

.section{padding-block:var(--sec-y)}
.section--tight{padding-block:clamp(52px,6vw,86px)}

/* ---- type scale ---------------------------------------------------------
   The display cap is set by the LONGEST headline line, measured, not guessed.
   The longest line on this page is "OPTIMISATION" (12 chars) in the hero H1,
   which at 64px Montserrat 800 is ~470px inside a 560px column. That leaves
   real headroom, so the cap can go a step above the DM page's 64px.
   Re-measure if the H1 copy ever changes.                                   */
.display{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:800;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,68px);
  line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:-.035em;
}
.h2{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:800;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,50px);
  line-height:1.06;
  letter-spacing:-.025em;
}
.h3{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(18px,1.5vw,21px);
  line-height:1.18;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
}
.h4{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(16px,1.2vw,18px);
  line-height:1.25;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
}
.lead{
  font-family:var(--body);
  font-weight:500;
  font-size:clamp(16px,1.35vw,19px);
  line-height:1.5;
}
.body{font-size:16px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--muted)}
.small{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}

/* ---- section heading block ---------------------------------------------- */
.sechead{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;
  gap:16px;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto clamp(38px,4.4vw,62px);
}
.sechead--left{align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;margin-inline:0}
.sechead__lede{font-size:clamp(16px,1.3vw,18px);line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted);max-width:64ch}
.sechead--on-dark .sechead__lede{color:var(--muted-on-dark)}
.sechead--on-dark .h2{color:#fff}

/* ---- pill label ---------------------------------------------------------
   Sentence case, filled, no letter-spacing. The user reads caps-tracked
   micro-labels as AI-made, so this component must never be uppercased.      */
.pill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:var(--body);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;
  padding:8px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  background:rgba(0,48,176,.10);color:var(--blue);
  letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;
}
.pill--on-dark{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
.pill--cyan{background:rgba(65,206,226,.18);color:#0E7A8B}
.pill--pink{background:rgba(242,66,119,.12);color:#C4104A}

/* ---- buttons ------------------------------------------------------------ */
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:16px;line-height:1;
  padding:18px 28px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:0;cursor:pointer;
  text-align:center;
  transition:transform var(--dur-hover) var(--ease),
             box-shadow var(--dur-hover) var(--ease),
             background-color var(--dur-hover) var(--ease-hover),
             color var(--dur-hover) var(--ease-hover);
}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px}

/* primary: yellow pill, ink label — dark grounds only */
.btn--primary{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink);
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(255,204,0,.28)}
.btn--primary:hover{background:#FFD633;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(255,204,0,.36)}

/* the light-surface primary, per the contrast rule at the top of this file */
.btn--blue{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,48,176,.24)}
.btn--blue:hover{background:#0038CC;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(0,48,176,.30)}

.btn--ghost-dark{
  background:transparent;color:#fff;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.42);
}
.btn--ghost-dark:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px #fff}

.btn--ghost{
  background:transparent;color:var(--ink);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line);
}
.btn--ghost:hover{background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(11,19,57,.24)}

.btn--sm{padding:13px 22px;font-size:14px}

/* round icon button (carousel arrows) */
.iconbtn{
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);
  display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;flex:0 0 auto;
  transition:background-color var(--dur-hover) var(--ease-hover),
             color var(--dur-hover) var(--ease-hover),
             border-color var(--dur-hover) var(--ease-hover);
}
.iconbtn:hover{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.iconbtn--on-dark{border-color:var(--line-on-dark);color:#fff}
.iconbtn--on-dark:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border-color:#fff}

/* a centred CTA row under a section */
.sec-cta{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:clamp(34px,4vw,54px)}
.sec-cta--left{justify-content:flex-start}

/* ---- motion primitives -------------------------------------------------- */
[data-reveal]{
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);
  transition:opacity var(--dur-reveal) var(--ease),
             transform var(--dur-reveal) var(--ease);
}
[data-reveal].is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}

[data-pop]{
  opacity:0;transform:scale(.72);
  transition:opacity 700ms var(--ease),transform 700ms var(--ease);
}
[data-pop].is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}

[data-float]{transform:translateY(var(--float-y,0));will-change:transform}

.visually-hidden{
  position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;margin:-1px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;
  clip:rect(0 0 0 0);clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap;border:0;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{
    animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;
    transition-duration:.001ms!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important;
  }
  [data-reveal],[data-pop]{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}
  [data-float]{transform:none!important}
}

/* ===========================================================================
   HERO — the search stage.

   The visual column is not a photograph. It is the page's subject rendered as
   a working object: a query types itself, an AI answer resolves beneath it,
   and the brand's own result climbs from position four to position one. That
   is the whole pitch, before a word of body copy.
=========================================================================== */

.hero{
  position:relative;
  isolation:isolate;
  background:var(--grad-climb);
  color:#fff;
  padding-top:clamp(112px,10vw,176px);
  padding-bottom:clamp(72px,8vw,116px);
  overflow:hidden;
}

/* the ascent ribbon. The global `svg{max-width:100%}` reset would silently
   clamp this and kill the bleed, so it is explicitly released. */
.hero__bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}
.hero__bg svg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none;
  display:block;
}
/* a soft dark veil at the top so the fixed header always has something to sit
   on, whatever slice of the ribbon happens to be showing */
.hero::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:220px;z-index:-1;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,17,77,.55),transparent);
  pointer-events:none;
}

.hero__inner{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.02fr .98fr;
  gap:clamp(28px,4vw,64px);
  align-items:center;
  min-height:min(78vh,760px);
}
/* Grid items default to min-width:auto, so the SERP rows' `white-space:nowrap`
   titles set the column's minimum and stretched the whole hero past the
   viewport on a phone. It reads as a broken layout and is invisible to a
   scrollWidth check, because the body clips its own overflow. */
.hero__inner > *{min-width:0}

.hero__copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.hero__badge{margin-bottom:22px}
.hero__title{margin:0 0 20px}
.hero__title .line{display:block}
.hero__sub{color:var(--muted-on-dark);max-width:36ch;margin-bottom:26px}

.hero__checks{
  list-style:none;margin:0 0 32px;padding:0;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;
}
.hero__checks li{
  position:relative;padding-left:30px;
  font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);
}
.hero__checks li::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:2px;
  width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--yellow);
}
.hero__checks li::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:5.5px;top:8px;
  width:8px;height:4px;
  border-left:2px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);
  transform:rotate(-45deg);
}

.hero__cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.hero__reply{margin-top:16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.58)}

/* the H1's second line carries a stroke that is flat, then rises: the page's
   argument in six pixels. It is sized off the line, not the column. */
.hero__title .line:last-child{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.hero__rule{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:-2%;bottom:-.14em;
  width:104%;height:auto;max-width:none;
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* ------------------------------- the stage ------------------------------
   A search results page. Everything here is in service of one thing: that it
   reads as a page of results and not as a form.

   The three things that made the previous version read as a form, all removed:
     1. rank badges (#1 #2 #3) beside every entry  -> an annotated diagram;
     2. an "Organic search results / Your brand" legend -> a diagram again;
     3. entries as identical bordered boxes of a fixed height -> a field list.
   Results are now plain text of naturally different heights on a white page,
   with no box, no border and no fill. The visitor's site is simply first.

   The layout convention (query field, tabs, count, overview, favicon + site +
   URL + link title + snippet) is the universal one. No search engine's logo,
   wordmark or brand colours are reproduced.
------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.hero__stage{position:relative;padding-block:34px}

.stage{
  background:#fff;
  border-radius:26px;
  /* the extra bottom padding is not decoration: the 96% chip hooks over this
     corner and is 85px tall once its label wraps, so without clear white here
     it lands on the last result's snippet and reads as a rendering fault */
  padding:clamp(15px,1.5vw,19px) clamp(15px,1.6vw,20px) clamp(40px,3.8vw,46px);
  box-shadow:0 40px 90px rgba(0,17,77,.42);
  color:var(--ink);
  max-width:516px;margin-inline:auto;
}

/* --- the query field ---
   A search field, with the tools a search engine puts in one. The old version
   was a bare filled rectangle with a caret, which is an input on a form; the
   clear button, the divider and the mic are what make this one read as the
   search box of a search engine instead. */
.srch{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;
  background:#fff;
  border:1px solid rgba(11,19,57,.14);
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(11,19,57,.07);
  padding:11px 15px;
}
.srch__glass{color:var(--muted-2);display:flex;flex:0 0 auto}
.srch__q{
  font-size:15.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);
  display:flex;align-items:center;min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;
}
.srch__caret{
  display:inline-block;width:1.5px;height:17px;margin-left:2px;
  background:var(--ink);border-radius:1px;flex:0 0 auto;
  animation:caret 1.05s steps(1) infinite;
}
@keyframes caret{0%,49%{opacity:1}50%,100%{opacity:0}}
.srch__tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;flex:0 0 auto}
.srch__x{color:var(--muted-2);display:flex}
.srch__div{width:1px;height:19px;background:rgba(11,19,57,.14);display:block}
.srch__mic{color:var(--blue);display:flex}

/* --- result tabs ---
   Cheap in height and instantly legible as a search engine. Sentence case, no
   letter-spacing, per the page's label rule. */
.tabs{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(14px,2vw,24px);
  margin-top:13px;padding:0 4px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(11,19,57,.09);
}
.tabs__t{
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);
  padding-bottom:9px;position:relative;white-space:nowrap;
}
.tabs__t.is-on{color:var(--blue);font-weight:700}
.tabs__t.is-on::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:2.5px;
  background:var(--blue);border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;
}

.stage__meta{
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted-2);
  padding:0 4px;margin:11px 0 0;
}
.stage__meta b{font-weight:400}

/* --- the results ---
   Plain text on white. No box, no border, no fill, no fixed height: entries
   are as tall as their own copy, which is the single clearest difference
   between a page of results and a stack of form fields. */
.res{list-style:none;margin:16px 0 0;padding:0 4px}
.res__i{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  opacity:1;transform:none;
  transition:opacity .34s var(--ease),transform .34s var(--ease);
}
.res__i + .res__i{margin-top:19px}

.res__site{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0}
.res__fav{
  flex:0 0 auto;width:23px;height:23px;border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#EDEFF6;color:var(--muted-2);
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:10.5px;
}
/* the visitor's own site is the only coloured mark, the way a real favicon is
   coloured among plainer ones. It is a cue, not an annotation. */
.res__fav--me{background:var(--grad-climb-soft);color:#fff}
.res__id{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;min-width:0}
.res__host{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25}
.res__url{
  font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted-2);line-height:1.25;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
.res__url i{font-style:normal;padding:0 4px}

/* the title wraps to two lines the way a real result's does. Nothing pins the
   rows to a shared height any more, so entries are naturally different sizes —
   which is most of what stops a list of them reading as a column of fields. */
.res__t{
  margin-top:5px;
  font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue);
  line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.005em;
  display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;
}
.res__s{
  margin-top:3px;
  font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted);
  display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;
}
/* a results page bolds the query terms it matched */
.res__s b{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-2)}

/* --- swapping one result set for the next ---
   Out together, back in top to bottom, the way a page paints. */
.stage__meta{transition:opacity .26s var(--ease),transform .26s var(--ease)}
.res__i:nth-child(2){transition-delay:70ms}
.res__i:nth-child(3){transition-delay:140ms}
.stage.is-swapping .stage__meta,
.stage.is-swapping .res__i{
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);
  transition-duration:.2s;transition-delay:0ms;
}

/* --- floating chips ---
   Offset down-right shadow, same device as the DM landing page's hero chips. */
.chip{
  position:absolute;
  background:#fff;color:var(--ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-chip);
  padding:14px 18px;
  box-shadow:var(--sh-chip);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;
  transform:translateY(var(--float-y,0));
  max-width:200px;
}
.chip__n{
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:24px;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;color:var(--blue);
}
.chip__l{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.35}
/* the chips sit OUTSIDE the stage's text, hooked over its top-left and
   bottom-right corners. Anything that overlaps the search bar or a result row
   reads as a rendering bug rather than a flourish. */
.chip--a{left:-30px;top:-34px}
.chip--b{right:-26px;bottom:-30px}
.chip--b .chip__n{color:var(--pink)}

/* ------------------------------ responsive ------------------------------ */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .chip--a{left:-12px}
  .chip--b{right:-10px}
}
@media (max-width:940px){
  .hero__inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:44px;min-height:0}
  .hero__copy{align-items:flex-start}
  .hero__sub{max-width:52ch}
  .hero__stage{max-width:560px;margin-inline:auto;width:100%}
  .chip--a{left:-6px;top:-30px}
  .chip--b{right:-6px;bottom:-26px}
}
@media (max-width:600px){
  /* The card was 518px on a 390x844 phone - about 72% of the usable screen once
     browser chrome is counted, which the client flagged. Everything below is
     that reduction: tighter frame, smaller type, and two results instead of
     three. A real results page is cut off by the fold on a phone anyway, so
     showing two is more faithful, not less. */
  .stage{padding:13px 13px 30px;border-radius:22px}
  .srch{padding:9px 12px}
  .srch__q{font-size:14.5px}
  .tabs{gap:14px;margin-top:11px}
  .tabs__t{font-size:12px;padding-bottom:8px}
  .stage__meta{margin-top:9px}
  .res{margin-top:13px}
  .res__i:nth-child(3){display:none}
  .res__i + .res__i{margin-top:14px}
  .res__fav{width:21px;height:21px;font-size:10px}
  .res__host{font-size:12px}
  .res__url{font-size:11px}
  .res__t{font-size:14px}
  .res__s{font-size:11.5px}
  .chip{padding:11px 13px;max-width:154px;border-radius:14px}
  .chip__n{font-size:19px}

/* ===========================================================================
   Section styles. One card treatment per section on purpose: the page should
   read as one family without ever repeating a layout.

     brands   logo rails, two speeds, opposite directions
     numbers  count-up figures on the dark gradient
     cases    split card, image left, evidence right
     journey  a track with a scroll-filled progress line
     whyus    bubble-masked photo above the text (the DM page's device)
     reviews  two counter-drifting rails of flat quote cards
     faq      accordion on the dark ground
     plan     two-column closer, contact left, form right
=========================================================================== */

/* ---------------------------- 2. BRANDS --------------------------------- */
.brands{background:var(--page);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
/* corner washes so a white-ish band is not a flat slab between two dark ones */
.brands::before,.brands::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
}
.brands::before{left:-220px;top:-260px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,48,176,.10),transparent 68%)}
.brands::after{right:-240px;bottom:-300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(65,206,226,.20),transparent 68%)}
.brands > *{position:relative;z-index:1}

.logorail{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(12px,1.4vw,18px);
  margin-block:clamp(6px,1vw,14px);
  /* fade both ends so the loop has no hard edge */
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 9%,#000 91%,transparent);
  mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 9%,#000 91%,transparent);
}
.logorail__rail{display:flex;width:max-content;transform:translateX(var(--marquee-x,0))}
.logorail__set{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(12px,1.4vw,18px);padding-right:clamp(12px,1.4vw,18px)}
/* Transparent cells, full colour, no card and no hover effect: the client
   wants the logo band to read exactly like the IM and DM pages' bands, which
   show the artwork and nothing else. */
.logocell{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  width:clamp(140px,14vw,200px);height:clamp(72px,7.4vw,104px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;
}
.logocell img{
  width:100%;height:100%;min-width:0;min-height:0;
  object-fit:contain;
}
/* Brother's artwork is white on transparent, so on a light ground it is
   literally invisible. Recolouring it to near-black is a legibility fix, not a
   styling effect, and it is what the IM page does with the same file. */
.logocell--ink img{filter:brightness(0);opacity:.82}

/* ---- awards plaque -------------------------------------------------------
   A dark inset inside the light trust section. Both marks are the client's own
   artwork: the a+m trophy is light silver and the Malaysia Book of Records mark
   is supplied black-or-white, so a single dark ground is the only surface that
   carries both. */
.awards{
  margin:clamp(30px,3.6vw,48px) auto 0;
  max-width:940px;
  background:var(--grad-climb-soft);
  border-radius:var(--r-panel);
  padding:clamp(24px,3vw,38px) clamp(22px,3vw,40px);
  box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(0,27,118,.24);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:clamp(22px,3vw,44px);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
/* one cyan wash so the plaque is not a flat navy rectangle */
.awards::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;right:-140px;top:-180px;
  width:460px;height:460px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(65,206,226,.30),transparent 68%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.award{
  position:relative;z-index:1;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(16px,2vw,26px);
}
.award + .award{
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  padding-left:clamp(22px,3vw,44px);
}
.award__mark{flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;place-items:center}
.award__mark img{width:auto;object-fit:contain}
/* the two marks are sized optically, not to a shared box: the trophy is
   portrait and the records mark is a wide wordmark */
.award__mark--trophy img{height:clamp(78px,7.6vw,104px)}
.award__mark--mbor img{height:clamp(52px,5.2vw,70px)}

.award__text{min-width:0}
.award__t{
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(15px,1.3vw,17.5px);line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.015em;
  color:#fff;margin:0 0 6px;
}
/* the a+m award carries no subline (client, 4 Sep), so the title is then the
   only child and its 6px trailing margin would push the block off centre */
.award__t:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.award__d{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,.76)}
.award__d b{color:var(--yellow);font-weight:800}

@media (max-width:820px){
  .awards{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px}
  .award + .award{
    border-left:0;padding-left:0;
    border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding-top:22px;
  }
}
@media (max-width:460px){
  /* stacked, the mark and its caption read better centred on the plaque than
     hard left against a wide dark panel (client, 4 Sep) */
  .award{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center}
  .award__text{text-align:center}
}

.badges{
  list-style:none;margin:clamp(26px,3vw,40px) 0 0;padding:0;
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;
  gap:12px clamp(18px,2.4vw,34px);
}
.badges li{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);
}
.badges__dot{
  width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;
  background:var(--grad-line);
}

/* ---------------------------- 3. NUMBERS -------------------------------- */
.numbers{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--grad-climb);color:#fff;
}
.numbers__glow{
  position:absolute;right:-180px;top:-220px;width:640px;height:640px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,204,0,.22),transparent 66%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.numbers .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
.numgrid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:clamp(14px,1.8vw,22px);
}
.numcard{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  border-radius:var(--r-card);
  padding:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px) clamp(18px,2vw,26px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:background .4s var(--ease),transform .4s var(--ease);
}
.numcard::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;
  background:var(--grad-line);opacity:.85;
}
.numcard:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.numcard__n{
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;
  font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,50px);line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--yellow);
}
.numcard__l{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.84);line-height:1.4}

@media (max-width:900px){.numgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:480px){.numgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ---------------------------- 7. CASES ---------------------------------- */
.cases{background:var(--page)}
.casegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px)}
.case{
  background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-panel);overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  transition:transform .5s var(--ease),box-shadow .5s var(--ease);
}
.case:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--sh-lift)}
.case__media{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;background:var(--navy-deep)}
.case__media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;
  transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
.case:hover .case__media img{transform:scale(1.045)}
.case__tag{
  position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px;
  background:rgba(0,17,77,.86);color:#fff;
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:7px 14px;
}
.case__body{padding:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.case__name{margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--navy)}
.case__lbl{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue);margin-top:10px}
.case__p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted)}
.case__pills{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:18px 0 0;padding:0}
.case__pills li{
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;
  background:var(--navy);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:8px 14px;
}
.case__pills li:nth-child(2){background:var(--pink)}

@media (max-width:820px){.casegrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ---------------------------- 8. JOURNEY -------------------------------- */
.journey{
  position:relative;overflow:clip;
  background:var(--ink);color:#fff;
}
.journey::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:-200px;bottom:-260px;
  width:620px;height:620px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,48,176,.55),transparent 68%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.journey .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}

.track{
  list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;
  --tgap:clamp(12px,1.6vw,22px);
  --tpad:20px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);
  gap:var(--tgap);
  position:relative;
}
/* The rail runs dot centre to dot centre, not edge to edge: a line that
   overshoots the last step reads as an unfinished process. The right-hand
   inset has to account for the grid gap as well as the column, or the rail
   stops short of the fifth dot by four fifths of a gap. */
.track::before,.track::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;
  left:calc(var(--tpad) + 11px);
  right:calc(20% - var(--tpad) - 11px - .8 * var(--tgap));
  top:26px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;
}
.track::before{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.track::after{
  background:var(--grad-line);
  transform:scaleX(var(--track-p,0));transform-origin:left;
  transition:transform .18s linear;
}

.jstep{
  position:relative;
  padding:52px var(--tpad) 24px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;
}
/* a glass panel behind each step, starting below the dot so the rail passes
   over open ground rather than across a card */
.jstep::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:40px;bottom:0;z-index:0;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-radius:var(--r-card);
  transition:background .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s var(--ease);
}
.jstep.is-done::before{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.20)}
.jstep > *{position:relative;z-index:1}

.jstep__dot{
  position:absolute;left:var(--tpad);top:16px;
  width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--ink);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  display:block;z-index:2;
  transition:background .4s var(--ease),border-color .4s var(--ease),
             box-shadow .4s var(--ease);
}
.jstep.is-done .jstep__dot{
  background:var(--yellow);border-color:var(--yellow);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(255,204,0,.16);
}
.jstep__step{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--cyan)}
.jstep__t{color:#fff}
.jstep__b{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:rgba(255,255,255,.76)}

/* No rail at three-up, so the dot has nothing to sit on: it moves inside the
   panel rather than floating above a card it is no longer connected to. */
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .track{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);row-gap:20px}
  .track::before,.track::after{display:none}
  .jstep{padding-top:24px}
  .jstep::before{top:0}
  .jstep__dot{position:static;margin-bottom:6px}
}
/* below the tablet breakpoint the five steps become a sticky stack: each card
   pins under the header and the next one slides over it. initStack() adds the
   settle-back scale and dim on the covered cards. */
@media (max-width:767px){
  .track{display:block}
  /* Stacked cards must be OPAQUE. A translucent card with a backdrop blur
     samples the card pinned underneath it, which smears the yellow dot's glow
     across the whole panel and reads as a rendering fault. */
  .jstep{
    position:sticky;top:calc(72px + var(--i,0) * 12px);
    background:#141D47;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
    border-radius:var(--r-card);
    padding:22px 20px 24px 20px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
    box-shadow:0 -10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    overflow:hidden;
    transform:scale(var(--stack-s,1));transform-origin:top center;
    transition:transform .2s linear;
  }
  .jstep::after{
    content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;z-index:3;
    background:var(--ink);opacity:var(--stack-d,0);
    pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s linear;
  }
  .jstep::before{display:none}
  .jstep__dot{position:static;margin-bottom:4px}
  .jstep:nth-child(1){--i:0}
  .jstep:nth-child(2){--i:1}
  .jstep:nth-child(3){--i:2}
  .jstep:nth-child(4){--i:3}
  .jstep:nth-child(5){--i:4}
}

/* ---------------------------- 9. WHY US --------------------------------- */
.whyus{background:var(--page)}
.whygrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px)}
.wcard{
  position:relative;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-panel);
  padding:clamp(16px,1.6vw,20px) clamp(18px,2vw,26px) clamp(26px,2.8vw,34px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  transition:transform .5s var(--ease),box-shadow .5s var(--ease);
}
.wcard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--sh-lift)}
/* the bubble mask: a rounded rectangle with one corner bitten out, so the
   coloured dot below can sit inside the notch */
.wcard__media{
  aspect-ratio:4/3;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;
  /* a semicircular bite out of the bottom edge, with the colour dot nesting
     inside it. Third card treatment on this page, deliberately unlike the
     problem tiles and the offer slats. */
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle 27px at 40px 100%,transparent 98%,#000 100%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(circle 27px at 40px 100%,transparent 98%,#000 100%);
}
.wcard__media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;
  transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
.wcard:hover .wcard__media img{transform:scale(1.05)}
/* The dot is a flex sibling pulled back over the photo's bottom edge, so it
   lands in the bite at any card height without needing a measured offset. */
.wcard__dot{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:block;
  margin:-13px 0 20px 40px;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(11,19,57,.22);
}
.wcard__dot--purple{background:var(--purple)}
.wcard__dot--blue{background:var(--blue)}
.wcard__dot--pink{background:var(--pink)}
.wcard__t{color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 10px}
.wcard__b{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--muted)}

@media (max-width:900px){.whygrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ---------------------------- 12. PLAN ----------------------------------- */

.plan__glow{

/* ===========================================================================
   The three title-first / comparison mechanics.

   Both reveal sections work the same way conceptually — the heading is what
   you see at rest, the body is what you earn — but they must not look alike,
   so they use opposite mechanics:

     problem cards   the card KEEPS its size and a coloured sheet rises over
                     the photograph to make room for the copy
     offer slats     the panel TAKES space from its neighbours and the copy
                     arrives in the space it won

   Both are hover-driven where there is a fine pointer and tap-driven where
   there is not; `html.is-touch` is set by the engine at boot, so the "Tap to
   read" affordance is pure CSS and never appears on a mouse.
=========================================================================== */

/* ==================== 4. PROBLEM CARDS ================================== */
.problem{background:var(--page)}
.pcards{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:clamp(16px,2vw,26px);
}

.pcard{
  position:relative;isolation:isolate;
  aspect-ratio:3/4;
  border-radius:var(--r-panel);
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--navy-deep);
  box-shadow:var(--sh-card);
  transition:transform .6s var(--ease),box-shadow .6s var(--ease);
}

/* the whole tile is the control. A real <button> so it is focusable, keyboard
   operable and announced, rather than a div with a click handler. */
.pcard__hit{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;
  background:none;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;
}
.pcard__hit:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:-6px;border-radius:inherit}

.pcard__media{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;display:block}
.pcard__media img{
  width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;
  transform:scale(1.02);
  transition:transform 1s var(--ease),filter .6s var(--ease);
}

/* resting scrim: enough to carry the title, not so much that the photo dies */
.pcard::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,19,57,0) 34%,rgba(11,19,57,.55) 62%,rgba(11,19,57,.88) 100%);
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* the sheet that rises on reveal */
.pcard__sheet{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;
  background:linear-gradient(158deg,rgba(0,27,118,.95) 0%,rgba(0,48,176,.94) 52%,rgba(31,168,188,.92) 100%);
  clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0);
  transition:clip-path .66s var(--ease);
  pointer-events:none;
}

.pcard__inner{
  position:relative;z-index:3;
  height:100%;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
  padding:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px);
  gap:12px;pointer-events:none;
}

.pcard__mark{
  width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff;
  backdrop-filter:blur(4px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
  margin-bottom:auto;
  transition:transform .55s var(--ease),background .45s var(--ease),color .45s var(--ease);
}

.pcard__t{
  color:#fff;
  transition:transform .55s var(--ease);
}

.pcard__b{
  font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.62;color:rgba(255,255,255,.90);
  max-height:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;
  transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:max-height .62s var(--ease),opacity .42s var(--ease),
             transform .62s var(--ease);
}

.pcard__tap{
  display:none;
  align-self:flex-start;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--yellow);border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  padding:6px 12px;margin-top:4px;
}

/* ---- the revealed state, reached by hover, focus or an explicit open ---- */
.pcard.is-open{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--sh-lift)}
.pcard.is-open .pcard__sheet{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}
.pcard.is-open .pcard__media img{transform:scale(1.08);filter:saturate(.55)}
.pcard.is-open .pcard__mark{transform:rotate(135deg);background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink)}
.pcard.is-open .pcard__b{max-height:18em;opacity:1;transform:none}
.pcard.is-open .pcard__tap{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}

@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  .pcard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--sh-lift)}
  .pcard:hover .pcard__sheet{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}
  .pcard:hover .pcard__media img{transform:scale(1.08);filter:saturate(.55)}
  .pcard:hover .pcard__mark{transform:rotate(135deg);background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink)}
  .pcard:hover .pcard__b{max-height:18em;opacity:1;transform:none}
}

/* the tap affordance exists only where there is no pointer to hover with */
.is-touch .pcard__tap{
  display:inline-block;
  transition:opacity .3s var(--ease),transform .3s var(--ease);
  animation:tapPulse 2.6s var(--ease) 3;
}
@keyframes tapPulse{
  0%,72%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}
  80%{transform:translateY(-3px)}
  88%{transform:translateY(0)}
}

@media (max-width:900px){
  .pcards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .pcards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .pcard{aspect-ratio:4/3}
}


/* ==================== 5. THE COMPARISON TABLE =========================== */
.method{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--navy);color:#fff;
}
.method__glow{
  position:absolute;right:-240px;top:-220px;width:720px;height:720px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(65,206,226,.26),transparent 66%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.method .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}

.cmp{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  border-radius:26px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  overflow:hidden;
  --cols:.8fr 1.05fr 1.5fr;
}
.cmp__head,.cmp__row{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--cols);align-items:stretch;
}
.cmp__row{
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);
  transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s var(--ease);
}
.cmp__row.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}

.cmp__c{
  padding:clamp(18px,1.9vw,26px) clamp(16px,1.6vw,24px);
  font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  transition:background .4s var(--ease),color .4s var(--ease);
}
.cmp__head .cmp__c{border-top:0}

.cmp__c--lbl{
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:14.5px;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.20);
  align-items:center;
}
/* the middle column is deliberately RECESSED and the right one LIT. Elevation
   here is done with contrast rather than shadow, because the panel clips its
   own overflow and a real raised slab would need the column to break out. */
.cmp__c--them{color:rgba(255,255,255,.66);background:rgba(0,0,0,.10)}

/* the MYSense column is one continuous raised slab: a shared gradient, a cyan
   edge and a shadow thrown left over the column beside it */
.cmp__c--us{
  color:#fff;font-weight:600;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,48,176,.72),rgba(31,168,188,.30));
  box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--cyan), -30px 0 50px rgba(0,10,45,.45);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
/* a light sweep crosses the winning cell as the pointer arrives */
.cmp__c--us::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(104deg,transparent 32%,rgba(255,255,255,.20) 50%,transparent 68%);
  transform:translateX(-70%);opacity:0;
  transition:transform 1s var(--ease),opacity .3s var(--ease);
}
.cmp__row.is-hot .cmp__c--us::after{opacity:1;transform:translateX(70%)}

.cmp__head .cmp__c{
  padding-block:clamp(15px,1.5vw,19px);
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(13.5px,1.15vw,16px);
  text-transform:none;letter-spacing:-.01em;
  align-items:center;
}
.cmp__head .cmp__c--them{background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}
.cmp__head .cmp__c--us{
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan-deep));
  color:#fff;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;
  padding-block:clamp(17px,1.8vw,23px);
}
.cmp__flag{
  font-family:var(--body);font-style:normal;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.86);
}

/* the two verdict marks, drawn rather than iconised so they inherit colour */
.cmp__x,.cmp__v{flex:0 0 auto;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;position:relative;margin-top:1px}
.cmp__x{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.cmp__x::before,.cmp__x::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:9px;height:1.8px;border-radius:2px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.62);
}
.cmp__x::before{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg)}
.cmp__x::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-45deg)}
.cmp__v{background:var(--yellow)}
.cmp__v::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:6px;top:6.5px;width:9px;height:4.5px;
  border-left:2px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);
  transform:rotate(-45deg);
}

/* hover focus: the table dims, the pointed-at row does not */
.cmp.is-focusing .cmp__row{opacity:.40}
.cmp.is-focusing .cmp__row.is-hot{opacity:1}
.cmp__row.is-hot .cmp__c--us{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,48,176,.85),rgba(31,168,188,.55));
  box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--yellow), -26px 0 50px rgba(0,10,45,.44);
}
.cmp__row.is-hot .cmp__c--lbl{background:rgba(0,0,0,.24);color:#fff}

.method__close{
  text-align:center;
  margin:clamp(24px,3vw,36px) auto 0;max-width:44ch;
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(17px,1.7vw,23px);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25;
  color:#fff;
}
.method__close em{font-style:normal;color:var(--yellow)}

/* --- mobile: the three columns become five stacked comparison cards ------ */
@media (max-width:860px){
  .cmp{background:none;border:0;gap:12px;overflow:visible}
  .cmp__head{display:none}
  .cmp__row{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
    border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .cmp__c{border-top:0}
  .cmp__c--lbl{
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.20);font-size:15px;
    padding-block:14px;
  }
  .cmp__c--them,.cmp__c--us{flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:relative;padding-left:clamp(16px,4vw,22px)}
  .cmp__c--them::before,.cmp__c--us::before{
    font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;
  }
  .cmp__c--them::before{content:'The usual approach';color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
  .cmp__c--us::before{content:'MYSense';color:var(--cyan)}
  .cmp__c--us{box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 var(--cyan)}
  .cmp__x,.cmp__v{display:none}
  .cmp.is-focusing .cmp__row{opacity:1}
}


/* ==================== 6. THE OFFER SLATS ================================ */
.offers{background:var(--page)}

.slats{
  display:flex;gap:clamp(10px,1.2vw,16px);
  height:clamp(380px,42vw,540px);
}
.slat{
  position:relative;isolation:isolate;
  flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;
  border-radius:var(--r-panel);
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--navy-deep);
  transition:flex-grow .66s var(--ease),box-shadow .5s var(--ease);
}
.slat.is-open{flex-grow:3.4;box-shadow:var(--sh-lift)}

.slat__img{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
  width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;
  filter:grayscale(.72) brightness(.62);
  transform:scale(1.04);
  transition:filter .7s var(--ease),transform 1.1s var(--ease);
}
.slat.is-open .slat__img{filter:grayscale(0) brightness(.78);transform:scale(1)}

/* a colour wash so six warm photographs still read as one blue page */
.slat::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,27,118,.42) 0%,rgba(0,17,77,.30) 40%,rgba(0,17,77,.94) 100%);
  transition:opacity .6s var(--ease);
}
.slat.is-open::before{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,27,118,.20) 0%,rgba(0,17,77,.42) 42%,rgba(0,17,77,.95) 100%);
}

.slat__hit{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:4;
  background:none;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;
}
.slat__hit:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:-6px;border-radius:inherit}

/* While a panel is closed its title runs up the left edge. Six titles across
   a 1176px row leaves each closed panel about 90px wide, and "Live competitor
   analysis" cannot be set horizontally in 90px without shredding. The spine
   solves that and is the reason this section can hold six panels at all. */
.slat__spine{
  position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;z-index:3;
  padding:clamp(16px,1.7vw,24px);
  writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(14px,1.15vw,17px);letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1;
  color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .3s var(--ease);
}
.slat.is-open .slat__spine{opacity:0}

.slat__face{
  position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;z-index:3;
  padding:clamp(16px,1.7vw,26px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);
  transition:opacity .38s var(--ease),transform .55s var(--ease);
}
.slat.is-open .slat__face{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* the rule above the title widens as the panel opens: a small, quiet cue that
   the panel is the live one */
.slat__face::before{
  content:'';display:block;height:3px;width:26px;border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--grad-line);
  transition:width .6s var(--ease);
}
.slat.is-open .slat__face::before{width:78px}

.slat__t{color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.slat__b{
  font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);
  max-width:46ch;
  max-height:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;
  transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:max-height .62s var(--ease),opacity .42s .1s var(--ease),
             transform .62s var(--ease);
}
.slat.is-open .slat__b{max-height:20em;opacity:1;transform:none}

.slat__tap{
  display:none;align-self:flex-start;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--yellow);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:6px 12px;
}
.is-touch .slat__tap{display:inline-block}
.is-touch .slat.is-open .slat__tap{display:none}

/* --- tablet and mobile: a vertical accordion, opened by tap -------------- */
@media (min-width:1025px){
  .slat__b{max-height:none;opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}
}

/* --- tablet and mobile: the spine goes away and it becomes a tap accordion */
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .slat__spine{display:none}
  .slat__face{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .slats{
    flex-direction:column;height:auto;
    gap:clamp(10px,1.4vw,14px);
  }
  .slat{
    flex:0 0 auto;height:104px;
    transition:height .6s var(--ease),box-shadow .5s var(--ease);
  }
  .slat.is-open{height:min(430px,66vw);flex-grow:0}
  .slat__face{padding:18px 20px}
  .slat__b{max-width:none}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .slat{height:96px}
  .slat.is-open{height:400px}
}

        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        panel.style.height = '0px';
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const open = item.classList.contains('is-open');
          items.forEach(o => {                       // single-open accordion
            o.classList.remove('is-open');
            const p = o.querySelector('[data-acc-panel]');
            const b = o.querySelector('[data-acc-btn]');
            if (p) p.style.height = '0px';
            if (b) b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          });
          if (!open) {
            item.classList.add('is-open');
            panel.style.height = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
            btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          }
        });
      });
      window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        root.querySelectorAll('.is-open [data-acc-panel]').forEach(p => {
          p.style.height = p.scrollHeight + 'px';
        });
      });
    });
  }

  /* -- 6. site header ------------------------------------------------------- */
  function initHeader() {
    const head = document.querySelector('.site-head');
    if (!head) return;
    const burger = document.querySelector('[data-nav-toggle]');

    const onScroll = () => head.classList.toggle('is-stuck', window.scrollY > 24);
    onScroll();
    addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });

    /* The mobile menu is a full-screen panel, the same one the influencer
       landing page uses. `hidden` is toggled as well as the class because the
       panel is fixed over the whole page: leaving it in the tree while
       invisible would trap taps and keep its links in the tab order. */
    const menu = document.getElementById('siteMenu');
    if (burger && menu) {
      const setOpen = open => {
        head.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
        menu.hidden = !open;
        burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
        document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
      };
      burger.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(!head.classList.contains('is-open')));
      menu.addEventListener('click', e => {
        if (e.target.closest('[data-nav-close]') || e.target.closest('a')) setOpen(false);
      });
      addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false); });
    }
  }

  /* -- 7. mobile sticky card stack ------------------------------------------ */
  /* The pinning itself is pure CSS. This only adds the depth cue: as the next
     card slides over a pinned one, the pinned card settles back and dims in
     proportion to how far it is covered. */
  function initStack() {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width:767px)');
    const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-stack] > *')];
    if (REDUCED || cards.length < 2) return;

    let ticking = false;
    const paint = () => {
      ticking = false;
      if (!mq.matches) {
        cards.forEach(c => {
          c.style.removeProperty('--stack-s');
          c.style.removeProperty('--stack-d');
          c.style.removeProperty('opacity');
        });
        return;
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < cards.length - 1; i++) {
        const mine = cards[i].getBoundingClientRect();
        const next = cards[i + 1].getBoundingClientRect();
        const p = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (mine.bottom - next.top) / mine.height));
        cards[i].style.setProperty('--stack-s', (1 - 0.06 * p).toFixed(4));
        /* The dim is a scrim INSIDE the card, not the card's own opacity.
           Fading the element itself makes it translucent, and since every card
           is also covering the one behind it, the card underneath shows
           straight through. */
        cards[i].style.setProperty('--stack-d', (0.42 * p).toFixed(3));
      }
    };
    const onScroll = () => { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(paint); } };
    addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
    paint();
  }

  /* =========================================================================
     NEW BEHAVIOURS FOR THIS PAGE
     ========================================================================= */

  /* -- 8. search typewriter -------------------------------------------------
     Types a query, holds, deletes, types the next. The full list is also in
     the DOM as visually-hidden text so the queries are still readable to a
     screen reader and to Google. Pauses while off screen so it is not burning
     frames the whole page long. */
  function initType() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-type]').forEach(el => {
      const words = (el.dataset.type || '').split('|').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (!words.length) return;
      const out = el.querySelector('[data-type-out]') || el;
      if (REDUCED) { out.textContent = words[0]; return; }

      const SPEED_IN = 62, SPEED_OUT = 28, HOLD = 1700, GAP = 380;
      let w = 0, i = 0, dir = 1, t = 0, visible = true;

      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => { visible = e.isIntersecting; }),
          { threshold: 0 }).observe(el);
      }

      const tick = now => {
        if (!t) t = now;
        if (visible && now - t >= (dir > 0 ? SPEED_IN : SPEED_OUT)) {
          t = now;
          i += dir;
          const word = words[w];
          if (i >= word.length) { i = word.length; dir = -1; t = now + HOLD; }
          else if (i <= 0) { i = 0; dir = 1; w = (w + 1) % words.length; t = now + GAP; }
          out.textContent = words[w].slice(0, i);
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      };
      out.textContent = '';
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    });
  }

  /* -- 9. the search stage --------------------------------------------------
     Ties the typed query to the results underneath it. Six searches live in a
     JSON block beside the stage; each carries its query, its result count and
     time, its AI overview and its three results. The cycle is: the results
     leave, the query retypes, the new results paint back in top to bottom.

     There is no rank animation any more. Rank badges and a climbing row are
     the marks of an annotated diagram rather than a results page, and a column
     of equal boxes under a query field is the shape of a form whatever the
     text in it says. The visitor's site is simply the first result.

     Search one is also present as real markup, so the stage is complete and
     crawlable with no JavaScript at all. */
  function initStage() {
    const card = document.querySelector('[data-stage]');
    if (!card) return;

    const src = (card.parentElement || document).querySelector('[data-stage-data]');
    const qOut = card.querySelector('[data-stage-q]');
    const countEl = card.querySelector('[data-stage-count]');
    const timeEl = card.querySelector('[data-stage-time]');
    const items = [...card.querySelectorAll('.res__i')];
    if (!src || !qOut || !countEl || !items.length) return;

    let data;
    try { data = JSON.parse(src.textContent); } catch (err) { return; }
    if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length < 2 || data[0].rows.length !== items.length) return;

    const rx = t => t.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

    /* A results page bolds the terms it matched, so the snippet is built as
       text nodes and <b> rather than assigned wholesale — no markup from the
       data ever reaches innerHTML. */
    const snippet = (el, text, query) => {
      el.textContent = '';
      const terms = query.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length >= 3);
      if (!terms.length) { el.textContent = text; return; }
      const re = new RegExp('(' + terms.map(rx).join('|') + ')', 'ig');
      text.split(re).forEach((part, i) => {
        if (!part) return;
        if (i % 2) {
          const b = document.createElement('b');
          b.textContent = part;
          el.appendChild(b);
        } else el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(part));
      });
    };

    const set = (root, sel, txt) => {
      const el = root.querySelector(sel);
      if (el) el.textContent = txt;
    };

    const paint = i => {
      const s = data[i];
      countEl.textContent = s.n;
      if (timeEl) timeEl.textContent = s.t;
      s.rows.forEach((r, n) => {
        const it = items[n];
        if (!it) return;
        set(it, '.res__fav', r.fav);
        set(it, '.res__host', r.host);
        set(it, '.res__path', r.path);
        set(it, '.res__t', r.title);
        const url = it.querySelector('.res__url');
        if (url) url.firstChild.nodeValue = 'https://' + r.host;
        const sn = it.querySelector('.res__s');
        if (sn) snippet(sn, r.snip, s.q);
      });
    };

    if (REDUCED) { paint(0); qOut.textContent = data[0].q; return; }

    const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
    let onScreen = true;
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => { onScreen = e.isIntersecting; }),
        { threshold: 0 }).observe(card);
    }
    /* hold between searches rather than typing into a hidden tab, where timers
       are throttled to about one a second and the typing would crawl */
    const ready = async () => { while (!onScreen || document.hidden) await sleep(400); };

    const IN = 56, OUT = 26, HOLD = 3400;
    const typeIn = async t => { for (let n = 1; n <= t.length; n++) { qOut.textContent = t.slice(0, n); await sleep(IN); } };
    const typeOut = async t => { for (let n = t.length; n >= 0; n--) { qOut.textContent = t.slice(0, n); await sleep(OUT); } };

    let i = 0;
    paint(0);
    qOut.textContent = '';
    /* the page opens by running a search rather than presenting a finished one */
    card.classList.add('is-swapping');

    (async () => {
      await ready();
      await sleep(600);
      await typeIn(data[0].q);
      await sleep(330);
      card.classList.remove('is-swapping');
      await sleep(HOLD);

      for (;;) {
        await ready();
        card.classList.add('is-swapping');
        await sleep(260);
        await typeOut(data[i].q);
        i = (i + 1) % data.length;
        paint(i);
        await sleep(180);
        await typeIn(data[i].q);
        await sleep(330);
        card.classList.remove('is-swapping');
        await sleep(HOLD);
      }
    })();
  }

  /* -- 10. title-first reveal cards ----------------------------------------
     Used by "The problem most brands face". At rest only the title shows; the
     body is revealed on hover with a fine pointer, and on tap otherwise. The
     tap affordance is a class on the card, so the "Tap to read" chip is pure
     CSS and never appears on a mouse device. Focus counts as hover for
     keyboard users, and Escape closes an open card. */
  function initHoverCards() {
    const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-hovercard]')];
    if (!cards.length) return;

    const close = except => cards.forEach(c => { if (c !== except) c.classList.remove('is-open'); });

    cards.forEach(card => {
      const btn = card.querySelector('[data-hovercard-btn]') || card;
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

      const setOpen = open => {
        card.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      };

      btn.addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const open = !card.classList.contains('is-open');
        close(card);
        setOpen(open);
      });

      // keyboard: focus opens, blur closes, matching the hover behaviour
      btn.addEventListener('focus', () => { if (CAN_HOVER) { close(card); setOpen(true); } });
      btn.addEventListener('blur', () => { if (CAN_HOVER) setOpen(false); });
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(null); });
    // tapping anywhere else closes the open card on touch
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if (!e.target.closest('[data-hovercard]')) close(null);
    });
  }

  /* -- 11. expanding slats --------------------------------------------------
     Used by "What MYSense SEO offers". A horizontal accordion: at rest every
     slat shows only its title, hovering one expands it and compresses the
     rest. Below the tablet breakpoint the same markup becomes a vertical
     accordion driven by tap. One slat is open by default so the section never
     reads as a row of empty columns.                                          */
  function initSlats() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-slats]').forEach(root => {
      const slats = [...root.querySelectorAll('[data-slat]')];
      if (!slats.length) return;
      const startIndex = parseInt(root.dataset.slats || 0, 10);

      const open = el => {
        slats.forEach(s => {
          const on = s === el;
          s.classList.toggle('is-open', on);
          const btn = s.querySelector('[data-slat-btn]');
          if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(on));
        });
      };

      slats.forEach((slat, i) => {
        const btn = slat.querySelector('[data-slat-btn]') || slat;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(i === startIndex));
        btn.addEventListener('click', e => {
          e.preventDefault();
          open(slat.classList.contains('is-open') && !CAN_HOVER ? null : slat);
        });
        if (CAN_HOVER) {
          slat.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => open(slat));
          btn.addEventListener('focus', () => open(slat));
        }
      });

      open(slats[startIndex] || slats[0]);
      if (CAN_HOVER) {
        root.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => open(slats[startIndex] || slats[0]));
      }
    });
  }

  /* -- 12. comparison table -------------------------------------------------
     Rows reveal in sequence as the table scrolls in, and hovering a row lifts
     it while dimming the others. The dimming lives on the table, not on each
     row, so there is one class toggle per pointer move rather than N.        */
  function initCompare() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-compare]').forEach(table => {
      const rows = [...table.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-row]')];
      if (!rows.length) return;

      if (REDUCED || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
        rows.forEach(r => r.classList.add('is-in'));
      } else {
        const io = new IntersectionObserver((es, obs) => {
          es.forEach(e => {
            if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
            const i = rows.indexOf(e.target);
            e.target.style.transitionDelay = (i * 90) + 'ms';
            e.target.classList.add('is-in');
            obs.unobserve(e.target);
          });
        }, { threshold: .2 });
        rows.forEach(r => io.observe(r));
      }

      if (!CAN_HOVER) return;
      rows.forEach(row => {
        row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          table.classList.add('is-focusing');
          rows.forEach(r => r.classList.toggle('is-hot', r === row));
        });
      });
      table.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        table.classList.remove('is-focusing');
        rows.forEach(r => r.classList.remove('is-hot'));
      });
    });
  }

  /* -- 13. journey progress line -------------------------------------------
     A scroll-linked line that fills as the five steps pass the middle of the
     viewport, and marks each step done as the line reaches it. Horizontal on
     desktop, vertical below the tablet breakpoint: the same 0..1 progress
     value drives both, only the CSS differs. */
  function initTrack() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(track => {
      const steps = [...track.querySelectorAll('[data-track-step]')];
      if (!steps.length) return;
      let ticking = false;

      const paint = () => {
        ticking = false;
        const r = track.getBoundingClientRect();
        const mid = window.innerHeight * 0.62;
        const p = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (mid - r.top) / Math.max(1, r.height)));
        track.style.setProperty('--track-p', p.toFixed(4));
        steps.forEach((s, i) => {
          s.classList.toggle('is-done', p >= (i + 0.35) / steps.length);
        });
      };
      const onScroll = () => { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(paint); } };
      addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
      addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
      paint();
    });
  }

  /* -- 14. tabbed case studies ---------------------------------------------- */
  function initTabs() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tabs]').forEach(root => {
      const btns = [...root.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-btn]')];
      const panes = [...root.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-pane]')];
      if (!btns.length) return;
      const select = i => {
        btns.forEach((b, n) => {
          b.classList.toggle('is-on', n === i);
          b.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(n === i));
          b.tabIndex = n === i ? 0 : -1;
        });
        panes.forEach((p, n) => { p.hidden = n !== i; p.classList.toggle('is-on', n === i); });
      };
      btns.forEach((b, i) => {
        b.addEventListener('click', () => select(i));
        b.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
          if (e.key !== 'ArrowRight' && e.key !== 'ArrowLeft') return;
          e.preventDefault();
          const n = (i + (e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) + btns.length) % btns.length;
          btns[n].focus(); select(n);
        });
      });
      select(0);
    });
  }

  /* -- boot ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const boot = () => {
    initReveal(); initMarquee(); initCounters(); initFloat();
    initAccordion(); initHeader(); initStack();
    initType(); initStage(); initHoverCards(); initSlats();
    initCompare(); initTrack(); initTabs();
  };
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  } else { boot(); }
})();
